runs.about: Product designer focused on building data-driven interfaces and tools that help users understand complex systems. Combines research, prototyping, and front-end development to ship high-impact product experiences.

bullets: Led UI/UX design and research for a DEX Tracking Platform from concept to launch, framing ambiguous problems into prioritized product opportunities to guide feature direction.
Collaborated closely with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to translate design intent into shippable features, shipping over 50 design enhancements that improved user experience.
Spearheaded company-wide design discovery research to uncover UX opportunities, launching a redesigned app that doubled average user retention time.
Created and managed feedback channels to accelerate iteration cycles, reducing feature feedback time from 2 days to 10 minutes and enabling faster learning.
Led end-to-end design and research to optimize trading workflows, reducing user search time by 75%.
Analyzed and proposed UI/UX redesigns for Binance Earn App Homepage to increase conversion rates through cross-product promotion, improving cross-functional execution quality.
Developed a Figma plugin that enabled designers to analyze over 2000 CSAT and NPS survey responses approximately 30% faster, enhancing team efficiency and tooling.
Redesigned error messaging across 6 product verticals, creating a more consistent content system that helped users recover faster and reduced churn.
Audited ShopeePay payment flows with stakeholders to identify friction and streamline the payment experience.
Planned, recruited, and conducted live usability testing with 10 participants to evaluate and refine product hypotheses.
Built and tested competing prototypes in Origami Studio and Figma to evaluate interaction patterns through A/B testing.
Identified 4 key usability improvements and translated them into UI and interaction updates that shipped.
Built components of a web app using React, gaining hands-on development experience to inform design decisions.
Redesigned and developed an online merchandise platform that increased user donations to charities by 40%, demonstrating impact through product redesign and development.
